skus.name: Women's Alpargata Rope Espadrille — Sage Canvas
skus.llmTriggerEvent: Spring/Summer Friends & Family 20% Promo + TikTok Styling Reel (+38% PDP saves)
skus.llmRationale: Historical Weeks -9 and -4 suffered 39% stockout censoring in Coastal Tier-1 stores, causing Legacy ERP to under-predict the upcoming W+3 promo peak by 41%. De-censored Chronos-2 baseline lifted P50 to 840 u/wk; Selective Context Agent applied an additional +14.5% lift (confidence 0.91 > 0.80 threshold) due to confirmed homepage hero slot and viral social velocity. Targeting P85 quantile to protect 67.5% gross margin.
skus.actionTitle: Expedite 640 Units DC-West → Coastal Flagship Cluster + Raise PO #8841 by +920 Units
skus.actionSummary: Reallocate 640 units from Inland DC excess to 18 Coastal stores before W+3 Promo window; expand vendor replenishment to P85 quantile.
skus.transferRoute: Rialto DC-West → SoCal & Sunbelt Tier-1 Stores (18 locs)

skus.name: Valencia Lug-Sole Platform Mule — Terracotta Suede
skus.llmTriggerEvent: End-of-Season Selling Window Compression (6 Wks Left) + Early Warm Weather Shift
skus.llmRationale: Legacy ERP moving average projects 460 u/wk based on early-season velocity, leaving 7.4 weeks of excess supply at end-of-season. Chronos-2 detects steep post-peak decay across suede transition footwear. Context Agent incorporates NOAA 14-day warm anomaly (-11% suede conversion) and triggers an immediate shallow 15% markdown in W+2 plus cancellation of 800 unshipped PO units to avoid a 55% end-of-season clearance bath.
skus.actionTitle: Trigger Early 15% Shallow Markdown in W+2 & Cancel 800 Uncommitted Units on PO #9012
skus.actionSummary: Accelerate sell-through by +38% via shallow 15% promo now rather than 55% liquidation at Week +7; de-commit open vendor capacity.
skus.transferRoute: Omnichannel Price Trigger + Vendor Open-to-Buy Trim

skus.name: Men's TRVL Lite Heritage Slip-On — Classic Navy
skus.llmTriggerEvent: Minor Regional Blog Mention Detected — Confidence 0.41 < 0.80 Threshold (Zero Adjustment Applied)
skus.llmRationale: Series exhibits high stability (CV = 0.11). Unstructured social signal showed a localized blog mention, but backtested validation proved adjusting core replenishment on low-confidence media signals increases WAPE by +2.3 pts. Selective LLM Guardrail blocked adjustment. However, Legacy ERP safety-stock buffer is bloated by +28%; trimming W+3 replenishment PO by -650 units frees $13,065 in working capital while maintaining 98.6% service level.
skus.actionTitle: Trim Bloated Safety-Stock Replenishment by -650 Units (LLM Adjustment Blocked by Guardrail)
skus.actionSummary: Maintain pure statistical + Chronos-2 ensemble forecast; release 2.1 weeks of redundant buffer stock without risking availability.

skus.name: Harbor Waterproof Chelsea Boot — Olive Waxed Suede
skus.routedModel: Chronos-2 Covariate Router + Regional Weather Agent
skus.llmTriggerEvent: Pacific Northwest & Northeast Atmospheric River Rain Forecast (Weeks +1 to +4)
skus.llmRationale: Waterproof boot demand displays a 2.4x elasticity spike when 10-day precipitation exceeds seasonal norms by >35%. Currently 48% of chain inventory is sitting in Sunbelt stores (0.3 wks sell-through) while Seattle, Portland, and Boston clusters face stockout in 9 days. Recommending lateral inter-store/DC transfer of 480 pairs to wet-weather markets.
skus.actionTitle: Rebalance 480 Pairs from Sunbelt Doors → PNW & Northeast Wet-Weather Cluster
skus.actionSummary: Capture regional rain-driven demand surge via lateral inventory rebalance instead of cutting new factory orders.
skus.transferRoute: Sunbelt Slow-Movers → PNW & Northeast Cluster (22 Stores)

skus.name: Tiny TOMS Youth Alpargata — Heritage Sunburst Print
skus.llmTriggerEvent: No Qualified External Context Signal — Pure Chronos-2 Intermittent Distribution Used
skus.llmRationale: Long-tail youth print exhibits intermittent store-level demand. Classical Croston/ETS methods drifted +31% high, accumulating 6.2 excess weeks of inventory in store backrooms. Chronos-2 zero-shot quantile distribution accurately captures the tail decay without needing LLM adjustment. Recommending consolidating store tail stock to DTC fulfillment and pausing W+4 replenishment (-500 units).
skus.actionTitle: Pause W+4 Replenishment (-500 Units) & Consolidate Store Tail Inventory to DTC Pool
skus.actionSummary: Eliminate 4.1 excess weeks of fragmented store stock by pooling long-tail sizes into centralized E-Commerce fulfillment.
skus.transferRoute: Store Tail Sweep → Columbus DTC Fulfillment Center

archetypeRoutingMatrix.routingRule: Low CV (<0.18) & >52 wks history → Statistical + TSFM Ensemble; strict LLM guardrail (>0.85 conf).

Remaining window <= 8 wks → Target P40 quantile + early shallow 15% markdown vs. late 55% slash.
<4 wks history → Vision + Attribute Cosine Top-3 priors fed into Chronos-2 + Week 1-2 size velocity.
